QF.id: XVI Code of Conduct and Investor Protection_24

answer.text: A web-based centralized grievance redress facility for online complaint filing, acknowledgement with a unique registration number, forwarding to the entity, ATR upload, and tracking, with further escalation through SMART ODR
A new trading platform for commodity derivatives
A new settlement system for commodity exchanges

explanation.text: The Logic: SCORES is described as a web-based centralized SEBI grievance redress system. Complaints can be filed online, the system generates an acknowledgement with a unique registration number, the complaint is forwarded to the entity, the entity uploads an Action Taken Report (ATR), and the investor can track progress. Further escalation is supported via SCORES/SMART ODR. The Trap: SCORES is not a trading platform, a credit-scoring system, or a settlement system — it is specifically a grievance-redress facility for investors. Note: SCORES gives each complaint a unique registration number for tracking. If the investor remains dissatisfied after the ATR, the matter can be escalated through SMART ODR, SEBI's online dispute resolution mechanism.
